<li><span>进阶技巧与最佳实践</span></li>

<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>环境准备与基础入门</span></h2>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>1. 安装 Selenium 与浏览器驱动</span></h3>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>安装 Selenium</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code># 使用pip安装最新版本<span><br><span>pip install selenium<span><br><span><br># 安装特定版本<span><br><span>pip install selenium==4.10.0<span><br><span><br># 在虚拟环境中安装(推荐)<span><br><span>python -m venv selenium_env<span><br>source<span>&nbsp;selenium_env/bin/activate &nbsp;# Linux/Mac<span><br><span>selenium_env\Scripts\activate.bat &nbsp;# Windows<span><br><span>pip install selenium<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>安装浏览器驱动</span></h4>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>从Selenium 4.0开始，提供了自动管理驱动的功能，但了解手动安装方法仍然很重要：</span></p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong>Chrome浏览器</strong><span>:</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>访问 ChromeDriver 下载页面</span></li>
<li><span>下载与本地Chrome版本匹配的驱动程序</span></li>
<li><span>将驱动添加到系统PATH中或在代码中指定路径</span></li>
</ul>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong>Firefox浏览器</strong><span>:</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>访问 GeckoDriver 下载页面</span></li>
<li><span>下载适用于你操作系统的版本</span></li>
<li><span>将驱动添加到系统PATH中或在代码中指定路径</span></li>
</ul>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong>Edge浏览器</strong><span>:</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>访问 Microsoft Edge Driver 下载页面</span></li>
<li><span>下载与本地Edge版本匹配的驱动程序</span></li>
</ul>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong>Safari浏览器</strong><span>:</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>Safari驱动已内置于macOS中</span></li>
<li><span>需要在Safari浏览器中启用开发者模式</span></li>
</ul>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>2. Selenium 4.x 新特性</span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Selenium 4.x引入了许多重要的改进和新功能：</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>相对定位器</strong><span>：允许基于其他元素的位置来查找元素</span></li>
<li><strong>Service对象</strong><span>：用于更好地管理驱动程序服务</span></li>
<li><strong>WebDriver Manager</strong><span>：自动管理驱动程序的下载和设置</span></li>
<li><strong>CDP(Chrome DevTools Protocol)支持</strong><span>：允许访问浏览器特定的功能</span></li>
</ul>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>3. WebDriver初始化方法</span></h3>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>使用Selenium Manager(推荐，Selenium 4.x)</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>from<span>&nbsp;selenium&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;webdriver<span><br>from<span>&nbsp;selenium.webdriver.chrome.service&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;Service<span><br><span><br># 自动管理驱动<span><br><span>driver = webdriver.Chrome()<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>传统方法(指定驱动路径)</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>from<span>&nbsp;selenium&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;webdriver<span><br>from<span>&nbsp;selenium.webdriver.chrome.service&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;Service<span><br><span><br># 指定驱动路径<span><br><span>service = Service(executable_path='/path/to/chromedriver'<span>)<span><br><span>driver = webdriver.Chrome(service=service)<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>配置浏览器选项</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>from<span>&nbsp;selenium&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;webdriver<span><br>from<span>&nbsp;selenium.webdriver.chrome.options&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;Options<span><br><span><br># 创建Chrome选项对象<span><br><span>chrome_options = Options()<span><br><span>chrome_options.add_argument("--headless"<span>) &nbsp;# 无头模式<span><br><span>chrome_options.add_argument("--window-size=1920,1080"<span>) &nbsp;# 设置窗口大小<span><br><span>chrome_options.add_argument("--disable-gpu"<span>) &nbsp;# 禁用GPU加速<span><br><span>chrome_options.add_argument("--disable-extensions"<span>) &nbsp;# 禁用扩展<span><br><span>chrome_options.add_argument("--proxy-server='direct://'"<span>) &nbsp;# 代理设置<span><br><span>chrome_options.add_argument("--proxy-bypass-list=*"<span>) &nbsp;# 绕过代理<span><br><span>chrome_options.add_argument("--start-maximized"<span>) &nbsp;# 启动时最大化窗口<span><br><span>chrome_options.add_experimental_option("prefs"<span>, {<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;"download.default_directory"<span>:&nbsp;"/path/to/download/directory"<span>, &nbsp;# 设置下载目录<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;"download.prompt_for_download"<span>:&nbsp;False<span>, &nbsp;# 禁用下载提示<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;"download.directory_upgrade"<span>:&nbsp;True<span>,<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;"safebrowsing.enabled"<span>:&nbsp;True<span><br><span>})<span><br><span><br># 初始化WebDriver<span><br><span>driver = webdriver.Chrome(options=chrome_options)<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>4. 基础浏览器操作</span></h3>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>from<span>&nbsp;selenium&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;webdriver<span><br><span><br># 初始化WebDriver<span><br><span>driver = webdriver.Chrome()<span><br><span><br># 窗口操作<span><br><span>driver.maximize_window() &nbsp;# 最大化窗口<span><br><span>driver.set_window_size(1920<span>,&nbsp;1080<span>) &nbsp;# 设置窗口大小<span><br><span>driver.set_window_position(0<span>,&nbsp;0<span>) &nbsp;# 设置窗口位置<span><br><span><br># 导航操作<span><br><span>driver.get('https://www.example.com'<span>) &nbsp;# 打开URL<span><br><span>driver.back() &nbsp;# 后退<span><br><span>driver.forward() &nbsp;# 前进<span><br><span>driver.refresh() &nbsp;# 刷新页面<span><br><span><br># 页面信息<span><br><span>title = driver.title &nbsp;# 获取页面标题<span><br><span>url = driver.current_url &nbsp;# 获取当前URL<span><br><span>page_source = driver.page_source &nbsp;# 获取页面源代码<span><br><span><br># Cookie操作<span><br><span>driver.add_cookie({"name"<span>:&nbsp;"key"<span>,&nbsp;"value"<span>:&nbsp;"value"<span>}) &nbsp;# 添加Cookie<span><br><span>cookies = driver.get_cookies() &nbsp;# 获取所有Cookies<span><br><span>driver.delete_cookie("key"<span>) &nbsp;# 删除特定Cookie<span><br><span>driver.delete_all_cookies() &nbsp;# 删除所有Cookies<span><br><span><br># 关闭操作<span><br><span>driver.close() &nbsp;# 关闭当前标签页<span><br><span>driver.quit() &nbsp;# 关闭浏览器，释放资源<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>5. 常见浏览器配置</span></h3>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>无头模式(Headless)</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>from<span>&nbsp;selenium&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;webdriver<span><br>from<span>&nbsp;selenium.webdriver.chrome.options&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;Options<span><br><span><br><span>chrome_options = Options()<span><br><span>chrome_options.add_argument("--headless"<span>)<span><br><span>driver = webdriver.Chrome(options=chrome_options)<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>使用代理</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>from<span>&nbsp;selenium&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;webdriver<span><br>from<span>&nbsp;selenium.webdriver.chrome.options&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;Options<span><br><span><br><span>chrome_options = Options()<span><br><span>chrome_options.add_argument('--proxy-server=http://proxyserver:port'<span>)<span><br><span>driver = webdriver.Chrome(options=chrome_options)<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>禁用图片加载(提高性能)</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>from<span>&nbsp;selenium&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;webdriver<span><br>from<span>&nbsp;selenium.webdriver.chrome.options&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;Options<span><br><span><br><span>chrome_options = Options()<span><br><span>prefs = {"profile.managed_default_content_settings.images"<span>:&nbsp;2<span>}<span><br><span>chrome_options.add_experimental_option("prefs"<span>, prefs)<span><br><span>driver = webdriver.Chrome(options=chrome_options)<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>元素定位与交互操作</span></h2>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>1. 元素定位基础</span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Selenium提供了多种定位元素的方法，每种都有其适用场景：</span></p>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>from<span>&nbsp;selenium&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;webdriver<span><br>from<span>&nbsp;selenium.webdriver.common.by&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;By<span><br><span><br><span>driver = webdriver.Chrome()<span><br><span>driver.get("https://www.example.com"<span>)<span><br><span><br># 1. 通过ID定位(最推荐，高效且唯一)<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.ID,&nbsp;"login-button"<span>)<span><br><span><br># 2. 通过Name属性定位<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.NAME,&nbsp;"username"<span>)<span><br><span><br># 3. 通过Class Name定位(不唯一时返回第一个匹配元素)<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.CLASS_NAME,&nbsp;"login-form"<span>)<span><br><span><br># 4. 通过Tag Name定位<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME,&nbsp;"button"<span>)<span><br><span><br># 5. 通过Link Text定位(完全匹配)<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.LINK_TEXT,&nbsp;"Forgot Password?"<span>)<span><br><span><br># 6. 通过Partial Link Text定位(部分匹配)<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.PARTIAL_LINK_TEXT,&nbsp;"Forgot"<span>)<span><br><span><br># 7. 通过CSS选择器定位(强大且灵活)<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,&nbsp;"#login-form .submit-button"<span>)<span><br><span><br># 8. 通过XPath定位(最强大但可能较慢)<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.XPATH,&nbsp;"//div[@id='login-form']//button"<span>)<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>2. 高级定位策略</span></h3>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>XPath进阶用法</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code># 绝对路径(从根节点开始)<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.XPATH,&nbsp;"/html/body/div/form/input"<span>)<span><br><span><br># 相对路径(从任意节点开始)<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.XPATH,&nbsp;"//input[@name='username']"<span>)<span><br><span><br># 使用contains()函数<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.XPATH,&nbsp;"//button[contains(@class, 'login')]"<span>)<span><br><span><br># 使用text()函数<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.XPATH,&nbsp;"//a[text()='Forgot Password?']"<span>)<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.XPATH,&nbsp;"//a[contains(text(), 'Forgot')]"<span>)<span><br><span><br># 使用AND和OR操作符<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.XPATH,&nbsp;"//input[@type='text' and @name='username']"<span>)<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.XPATH,&nbsp;"//button[@type='submit' or @type='button']"<span>)<span><br><span><br># 通过父子关系定位<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.XPATH,&nbsp;"//form[@id='login-form']/input"<span>)<span><br><span>parent = driver.find_element(By.XPATH,&nbsp;"//input[@id='username']/.."<span>)<span><br><span><br># 通过兄弟关系定位<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.XPATH,&nbsp;"//input[@id='username']/following-sibling::input"<span>)<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.XPATH,&nbsp;"//input[@id='password']/preceding-sibling::input"<span>)<span><br><span><br># 按索引定位<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.XPATH,&nbsp;"(//input[@type='text'])[2]"<span>)<span><br><span><br># 使用轴(axes)<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.XPATH,&nbsp;"//input[@id='username']/ancestor::form"<span>)<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.XPATH,&nbsp;"//form/descendant::input"<span>)<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>CSS选择器进阶用法</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code># 基本选择器<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,&nbsp;"#login-button"<span>) &nbsp;# ID选择器<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,&nbsp;".login-form"<span>) &nbsp; &nbsp;# Class选择器<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,&nbsp;"input"<span>) &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;# 标签选择器<span><br><span><br># 属性选择器<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,&nbsp;"input[name='username']"<span>)<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,&nbsp;"input[name^='user']"<span>) &nbsp;# 以user开头<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,&nbsp;"input[name$='name']"<span>) &nbsp;# 以name结尾<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,&nbsp;"input[name*='erna']"<span>) &nbsp;# 包含erna<span><br><span><br># 组合选择器<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,&nbsp;"form input[type='text']"<span>)<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,&nbsp;"form &gt; input"<span>) &nbsp;# 直接子元素<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,&nbsp;"label + input"<span>) &nbsp;# 紧邻兄弟元素<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,&nbsp;"label ~ input"<span>) &nbsp;# 通用兄弟元素<span><br><span><br># 伪类选择器<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,&nbsp;"input:first-child"<span>)<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,&nbsp;"input:last-child"<span>)<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,&nbsp;"input:nth-child(2)"<span>)<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>相对定位器(Selenium 4.x新特性)</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>from<span>&nbsp;selenium.webdriver.support.relative_locator&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;locate_with<span><br><span><br># 获取参考元素<span><br><span>username_field = driver.find_element(By.ID,&nbsp;"username"<span>)<span><br><span><br># 使用相对定位器<span><br><span>password_field = driver.find_element(locate_with(By.TAG_NAME,&nbsp;"input"<span>).below(username_field))<span><br><span>login_button = driver.find_element(locate_with(By.TAG_NAME,&nbsp;"button"<span>).below(password_field))<span><br><span>remember_me = driver.find_element(locate_with(By.TAG_NAME,&nbsp;"input"<span>).to_right_of(password_field))<span><br><span>forgot_password = driver.find_element(locate_with(By.TAG_NAME,&nbsp;"a"<span>).above(login_button))<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>3. 查找多个元素</span></h3>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code># 查找所有符合条件的元素<span><br><span>elements = driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR,&nbsp;".product-item"<span>)<span><br><span><br># 遍历元素列表<span><br>for<span>&nbsp;element&nbsp;in<span>&nbsp;elements:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; name = element.find_element(By.CLASS_NAME,&nbsp;"product-name"<span>).text<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; price = element.find_element(By.CLASS_NAME,&nbsp;"product-price"<span>).text<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; print(<span>f"产品名称:&nbsp;<span>{name}<span>, 价格:&nbsp;<span>{price}<span>"<span>)<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>4. 元素交互操作</span></h3>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code># 输入操作<span><br><span>element.send_keys("test@example.com"<span>) &nbsp;# 输入文本<span><br><span>element.send_keys(Keys.CONTROL,&nbsp;'a'<span>) &nbsp;&nbsp;# 键盘组合键(全选)<span><br><span>element.send_keys(Keys.BACK_SPACE) &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;# 退格键<span><br><span><br># 点击操作<span><br><span>element.click() &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;# 点击元素<span><br><span>element.submit() &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;# 提交表单(适用于表单元素内)<span><br><span><br># 清除操作<span><br><span>element.clear() &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;# 清除文本输入框<span><br><span><br># 获取元素属性和状态<span><br><span>value = element.get_attribute("value"<span>) &nbsp;# 获取属性值<span><br><span>text = element.text &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;# 获取元素文本内容<span><br><span>tag = element.tag_name &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;# 获取标签名<span><br><span>size = element.size &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;# 获取元素大小<span><br><span>location = element.location &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;# 获取元素位置<span><br><span>is_enabled = element.is_enabled() &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;# 元素是否启用<span><br><span>is_selected = element.is_selected() &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;# 元素是否选中(复选框、单选按钮等)<span><br><span>is_displayed = element.is_displayed() &nbsp;&nbsp;# 元素是否可见<span><br><span><br># 特殊元素操作<span><br># 下拉菜单<span><br>from<span>&nbsp;selenium.webdriver.support.select&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;Select<span><br><span>select = Select(driver.find_element(By.ID,&nbsp;"dropdown"<span>))<span><br><span>select.select_by_visible_text("Option 1"<span>) &nbsp;# 通过文本选择<span><br><span>select.select_by_value("option1"<span>) &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;# 通过值选择<span><br><span>select.select_by_index(1<span>) &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;# 通过索引选择<span><br><span>options = select.options &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;# 获取所有选项<span><br><span>first_option = select.first_selected_option &nbsp;# 获取当前选中选项<span><br><span>select.deselect_all() &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;# 取消所有选择(多选下拉框)<span><br><span><br># 复选框和单选按钮<span><br><span>checkbox = driver.find_element(By.ID,&nbsp;"checkbox"<span>)<span><br>ifnot<span>&nbsp;checkbox.is_selected():<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; checkbox.click()<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>5. 元素查找最佳实践</span></h3>
<ol class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>性能优化顺序</strong><span>：ID &gt; Name &gt; CSS &gt; XPath</span></li>
<li><strong>避免使用</strong><span>：</span></li>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>绝对XPath路径(容易失效)</span></li>
<li><span>基于视觉位置的选择器</span></li>
<li><span>多级嵌套CSS选择器</span></li>
</ul>
<li><strong>推荐使用</strong><span>：</span></li>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>有意义的ID和名称属性</span></li>
<li><span>数据测试属性(如<code><span>data-testid</span></code><span>)</span></span></li>
<li><span>短而明确的CSS选择器</span></li>
</ul>
<li><strong>建议添加</strong><span>：</span></li>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>页面加载和元素的等待机制</span></li>
<li><span>查找元素的超时和重试机制</span></li>
<li><span>详细的错误处理机制</span></li>
</ul>
</ol><hr>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>等待机制与异常处理</span></h2>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>1. 等待策略</span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>在Web自动化中，页面加载和元素渲染需要时间，等待机制至关重要。</span></p>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>隐式等待(Implicit Wait)</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code># 设置隐式等待时间(全局设置)<span><br><span>driver.implicitly_wait(10<span>) &nbsp;# 等待最多10秒直到元素出现<span><br></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>隐式等待会在查找元素时自动等待一段时间直到元素出现，如果在指定时间内未找到元素，则抛出异常。</span></p>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>显式等待(Explicit Wait)</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>from<span>&nbsp;selenium.webdriver.support.ui&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;WebDriverWait<span><br>from<span>&nbsp;selenium.webdriver.support&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;expected_conditions&nbsp;as<span>&nbsp;EC<span><br><span><br># 等待元素可见<span><br><span>element = WebDriverWait(driver,&nbsp;10<span>).until(<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.ID,&nbsp;"element_id"<span>))<span><br><span>)<span><br><span><br># 等待元素可点击<span><br><span>element = WebDriverWait(driver,&nbsp;10<span>).until(<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.ID,&nbsp;"button_id"<span>))<span><br><span>)<span><br><span><br># 等待页面标题包含特定文本<span><br><span>WebDriverWait(driver,&nbsp;10<span>).until(<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; EC.title_contains("Home Page"<span>)<span><br><span>)<span><br><span><br># 等待元素消失<span><br><span>WebDriverWait(driver,&nbsp;10<span>).until(<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; EC.invisibility_of_element_located((By.CLASS_NAME,&nbsp;"loading"<span>))<span><br><span>)<span><br><span><br># 等待警告框出现<span><br><span>WebDriverWait(driver,&nbsp;10<span>).until(<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; EC.alert_is_present()<span><br><span>)<span><br><span><br># 等待元素的文本内容满足条件<span><br><span>WebDriverWait(driver,&nbsp;10<span>).until(<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; EC.text_to_be_present_in_element((By.ID,&nbsp;"status"<span>),&nbsp;"Success"<span>)<span><br><span>)<span><br><span><br># 等待元素的属性值满足条件<span><br><span>WebDriverWait(driver,&nbsp;10<span>).until(<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; EC.text_to_be_present_in_element_attribute((By.ID,&nbsp;"input"<span>),&nbsp;"value"<span>,&nbsp;"text"<span>)<span><br><span>)<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>自定义等待条件</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>from<span>&nbsp;selenium.webdriver.support.ui&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;WebDriverWait<span><br><span><br># 自定义等待条件<span><br><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>element_has_class<span>(element, class_name)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return<span>&nbsp;class_name&nbsp;in<span>&nbsp;element.get_attribute("class"<span>).split()<span><br><span><br># 使用自定义等待条件<span><br><span>element = driver.find_element(By.ID,&nbsp;"myElement"<span>)<span><br><span>WebDriverWait(driver,&nbsp;10<span>).until(lambda<span>&nbsp;driver: element_has_class(element,&nbsp;"active"<span>))<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>流畅等待(FluentWait)</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>from<span>&nbsp;selenium.webdriver.support.ui&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;WebDriverWait<span><br>from<span>&nbsp;selenium.common.exceptions&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;NoSuchElementException, StaleElementReferenceException<span><br><span><br># 创建FluentWait实例<span><br><span>wait = WebDriverWait(<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; driver,<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; timeout=30<span>,<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; poll_frequency=2<span>, &nbsp;# 每2秒检查一次<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; ignored_exceptions=[NoSuchElementException, StaleElementReferenceException]<span><br><span>)<span><br><span><br># 使用FluentWait<span><br><span>element = wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.ID,&nbsp;"myElement"<span>)))<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>2. 异常处理</span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Selenium操作可能会触发各种异常，合理的异常处理可以提高脚本的健壮性。</span></p>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>常见异常类型</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>from<span>&nbsp;selenium.common.exceptions&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;(<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; NoSuchElementException, &nbsp;# 元素未找到<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; TimeoutException, &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;# 等待超时<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; ElementNotVisibleException, &nbsp;# 元素不可见<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; ElementNotInteractableException, &nbsp;# 元素不可交互<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; StaleElementReferenceException, &nbsp;# 元素已过时(DOM已更新)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; WebDriverException, &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;# WebDriver通用异常<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; InvalidSelectorException, &nbsp;# 无效的选择器<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; UnexpectedAlertPresentException, &nbsp;# 意外的警告框<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; NoAlertPresentException, &nbsp;# 没有警告框<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; SessionNotCreatedException, &nbsp;# 会话创建失败<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; ElementClickInterceptedException &nbsp;# 元素点击被拦截<span><br><span>)<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>基本异常处理</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>try<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; element = driver.find_element(By.ID,&nbsp;"non_existent_element"<span>)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; element.click()<span><br>except<span>&nbsp;NoSuchElementException:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; print("元素未找到"<span>)<span><br>except<span>&nbsp;ElementNotInteractableException:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; print("元素不可交互"<span>)<span><br>except<span>&nbsp;Exception&nbsp;as<span>&nbsp;e:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; print(<span>f"发生其他异常:&nbsp;<span>{e}<span>"<span>)<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>重试机制</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>retry_click<span>(driver, by, value, max_attempts=<span>3<span>, wait_time=<span>1<span>)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>"""<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; 尝试多次点击元素<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; """<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;from<span>&nbsp;time&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;sleep<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;for<span>&nbsp;attempt&nbsp;in<span>&nbsp;range(max_attempts):<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;try<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; element = driver.find_element(by, value)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; element.click()<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;returnTrue<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;except<span>&nbsp;(NoSuchElementException, ElementNotInteractableException,&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ElementClickInterceptedException, StaleElementReferenceException)&nbsp;as<span>&nbsp;e:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;if<span>&nbsp;attempt == max_attempts -&nbsp;1<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print(<span>f"无法点击元素，错误:&nbsp;<span>{e}<span>"<span>)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;returnFalse<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; sleep(wait_time)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;returnFalse<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>处理StaleElementReferenceException</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>get_fresh_element<span>(driver, by, value)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>"""<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; 获取一个新鲜的元素引用，避免StaleElementReferenceException<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; """<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;try<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return<span>&nbsp;driver.find_element(by, value)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;except<span>&nbsp;StaleElementReferenceException:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;# 重新查找元素<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return<span>&nbsp;driver.find_element(by, value)<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>使用装饰器处理异常</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>import<span>&nbsp;functools<span><br>from<span>&nbsp;time&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;sleep<span><br><span><br><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>retry<span>(max_attempts=<span>3<span>, wait_time=<span>1<span>)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>"""<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; 函数重试装饰器<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; """<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>decorator<span>(func)<span>:<span><br>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; @functools.wraps(func)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>wrapper<span>(*args, **kwargs)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;for<span>&nbsp;attempt&nbsp;in<span>&nbsp;range(max_attempts):<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;try<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return<span>&nbsp;func(*args, **kwargs)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;except<span>&nbsp;(NoSuchElementException, ElementNotInteractableException,&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; StaleElementReferenceException)&nbsp;as<span>&nbsp;e:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;if<span>&nbsp;attempt == max_attempts -&nbsp;1<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;raise<span>&nbsp;e<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; sleep(wait_time)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return<span>&nbsp;wrapper<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return<span>&nbsp;decorator<span><br><span><br># 使用装饰器<span><br>@retry(max_attempts=5, wait_time=2)<span><br><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>click_element<span>(driver, by, value)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; driver.find_element(by, value).click()<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>3. 等待策略最佳实践</span></h3>
<ol class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong><span>避免使用<code><span>time.sleep()</span></code></span></strong><span>：不灵活且低效</span></li>
<li><strong>优先使用显式等待</strong><span>：更精确，可控性更强</span></li>
<li><strong>结合使用隐式等待和显式等待</strong><span>：隐式等待作为全局保护，显式等待针对特定场景</span></li>
<li><strong>设置合理的超时时间</strong><span>：不要过长或过短</span></li>
<li><strong>捕获并处理超时异常</strong><span>：提供适当的恢复机制或用户友好的错误信息</span></li>
<li><strong>为不同网络环境调整等待策略</strong><span>：可配置的超时参数</span></li>
</ol><hr>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>面向对象封装与框架设计</span></h2>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>1. 页面对象模型(Page Object Model, POM)</span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>页面对象模型是一种设计模式，将页面的元素和操作封装在类中，使测试代码更加清晰和可维护。</span></p>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>基本POM结构</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code><span>class<span>&nbsp;<span>BasePage<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>"""<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; 所有页面的基类<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; """<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>__init__<span>(self, driver)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; self.driver = driver<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>find_element<span>(self, locator)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return<span>&nbsp;self.driver.find_element(*locator)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>find_elements<span>(self, locator)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return<span>&nbsp;self.driver.find_elements(*locator)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>click<span>(self, locator)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; self.find_element(locator).click()<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>input_text<span>(self, locator, text)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; element = self.find_element(locator)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; element.clear()<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; element.send_keys(text)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>get_text<span>(self, locator)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return<span>&nbsp;self.find_element(locator).text<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>is_element_present<span>(self, locator)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;try<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; self.find_element(locator)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;returnTrue<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;except<span>&nbsp;NoSuchElementException:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;returnFalse<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>wait_for_element<span>(self, locator, timeout=<span>10<span>)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;try<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; WebDriverWait(self.driver, timeout).until(<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; EC.presence_of_element_located(locator)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; <h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>使用POM进行测试</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>test_login_success<span>()<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; driver = webdriver.Chrome()<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;try<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; login_page = LoginPage(driver)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; dashboard_page = login_page.login("valid_user"<span>,&nbsp;"valid_password"<span>)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;assert<span>&nbsp;dashboard_page.is_loaded()<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;assert"Welcome"in<span>&nbsp;dashboard_page.get_welcome_message()<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;finally<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; driver.quit()<span><br><span><br><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>test_login_failure<span>()<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; driver = webdriver.Chrome()<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;try<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; login_page = LoginPage(driver)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; result_page = login_page.login("invalid_user"<span>,&nbsp;"invalid_password"<span>)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;assert<span>&nbsp;isinstance(result_page, LoginPage)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;assert"Invalid credentials"in<span>&nbsp;result_page.get_error_message()<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;finally<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; driver.quit()<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>2. 测试框架集成</span></h3>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>与unittest集成</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>import<span>&nbsp;unittest<span><br>from<span>&nbsp;selenium&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;webdriver<span><br>from<span>&nbsp;selenium.webdriver.chrome.service&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;Service<span><br>from<span>&nbsp;webdriver_manager.chrome&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;ChromeDriverManager<span><br><span><br><span>class<span>&nbsp;<span>TestLogin<span>(unittest.TestCase)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>setUp<span>(self)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; self.driver = webdriver.Chrome(service=Service(ChromeDriverManager().install()))<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; self.driver.maximize_window()<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; self.login_page = LoginPage(self.driver)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>tearDown<span>(self)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; self.driver.quit()<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>test_valid_login<span>(self)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; dashboard_page = self.login_page.login("valid_user"<span>,&nbsp;"valid_password"<span>)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; self.assertTrue(dashboard_page.is_loaded())<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; self.assertIn("Welcome"<span>, dashboard_page.get_welcome_message())<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>test_invalid_login<span>(self)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; result_page = self.login_page.login("invalid_user"<span>,&nbsp;"invalid_password"<span>)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; self.assertIsInstance(result_page, LoginPage)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; self.assertIn("Invalid credentials"<span>, result_page.get_error_message())<span><br><span><br>if<span>&nbsp;__name__ ==&nbsp;"__main__"<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; unittest.main()<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>与pytest集成</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>import<span>&nbsp;pytest<span><br>from<span>&nbsp;selenium&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;webdriver<span><br>from<span>&nbsp;selenium.webdriver.chrome.service&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;Service<span><br>from<span>&nbsp;webdriver_manager.chrome&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;ChromeDriverManager<span><br><span><br>@pytest.fixture<span><br><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>driver<span>()<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; <h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>与Behave(BDD)集成</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code># features/login.feature<span><br><span>Feature: User Login<span><br><span>&nbsp; As a user<span><br><span>&nbsp; I want to be able to login to the application<span><br><span>&nbsp; So that I can access my account<span><br><span><br><span>&nbsp; Scenario: Successful login&nbsp;with<span>&nbsp;valid credentials<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; Given the user&nbsp;is<span>&nbsp;on the login page<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; When the user enters&nbsp;"valid_user"as<span>&nbsp;username<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; And the user enters&nbsp;"valid_password"as<span>&nbsp;password<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; And the user clicks the login button<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; Then the user should be redirected to the dashboard<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; And the dashboard should display a welcome message<span><br><span><br><span>&nbsp; Scenario: Failed login&nbsp;with<span>&nbsp;invalid credentials<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; Given the user&nbsp;is<span>&nbsp;on the login page<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; When the user enters&nbsp;"invalid_user"as<span>&nbsp;username<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; And the user enters&nbsp;"invalid_password"as<span>&nbsp;password<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; And the user clicks the login button<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; Then the user should remain on the login page<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; And an error message should be displayed<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code># steps/login_steps.py<span><br>from<span>&nbsp;behave&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;given, when, then<span><br>from<span>&nbsp;pages.login_page&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;LoginPage<span><br>from<span>&nbsp;pages.dashboard_page&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;DashboardPage<span><br><span><br>@given('the user is on the login page')<span><br><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>step_impl<span>(context)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; context.login_page = LoginPage(context.driver)<span><br><span><br>@when('the user enters "{username}" as username')<span><br><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>step_impl<span>(context, username)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; context.login_page.enter_username(username)<span><br><span><br>@when('the user enters "{password}" as password')<span><br><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>step_impl<span>(context, password)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; context.login_page.enter_password(password)<span><br><span><br>@when('the user clicks the login button')<span><br><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>step_impl<span>(context)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; context.result_page = context.login_page.click_login()<span><br><span><br>@then('the user should be redirected to the dashboard')<span><br><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>step_impl<span>(context)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;assert<span>&nbsp;isinstance(context.result_page, DashboardPage)<span><br><span><br>@then('the dashboard should display a welcome message')<span><br><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>step_impl<span>(context)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;assert"Welcome"in<span>&nbsp;context.result_page.get_welcome_message()<span><br><span><br>@then('the user should remain on the login page')<span><br><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>step_impl<span>(context)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;assert<span>&nbsp;isinstance(context.result_page, LoginPage)<span><br><span><br>@then('an error message should be displayed')<span><br><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>step_impl<span>(context)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;assert"Invalid credentials"in<span>&nbsp;context.result_page.get_error_message()<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>3. 高级框架设计模式</span></h3>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>工厂模式</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code><span>class<span>&nbsp;<span>PageFactory<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>"""<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; 页面对象工厂类<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; """<span><br>&nbsp; &nbsp; @staticmethod<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>get_page<span>(page_name, driver)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; pages = {<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;"login"<span>: LoginPage,<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;"dashboard"<span>: DashboardPage,<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;"profile"<span>: ProfilePage,<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;"settings"<span>: SettingsPage<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;if<span>&nbsp;page_name.lower()&nbsp;notin<span>&nbsp;pages:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;raise<span>&nbsp;ValueError(<span>f"不支持的页面:&nbsp;<span>{page_name}<span>"<span>)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return<span>&nbsp;pages[page_name.lower()](driver)<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>单例模式(驱动管理器)</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code><span>class<span>&nbsp;<span>WebDriverManager<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>"""<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; WebDriver管理器(单例模式)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; """<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; _instance =&nbsp;None<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>__new__<span>(cls)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;if<span>&nbsp;cls._instance&nbsp;isNone<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; cls._instance = super(WebDriverManager, cls).__new__(cls)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; cls._instance.driver =&nbsp;None<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return<span>&nbsp;cls._instance<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>get_driver<span>(self, browser=<span>"chrome"<span>)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;if<span>&nbsp;self.driver&nbsp;isNone<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;if<span>&nbsp;browser.lower() ==&nbsp;"chrome"<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; self.driver = webdriver.Chrome()<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;elif<span>&nbsp;browser.lower() ==&nbsp;"firefox"<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; self.driver = webdriver.Firefox()<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;else<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;raise<span>&nbsp;ValueError(<span>f"不支持的浏览器:&nbsp;<span>{browser}<span>"<span>)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; self.driver.maximize_window()<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; self.driver.implicitly_wait(10<span>)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return<span>&nbsp;self.driver<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>quit<span>(self)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; <h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>策略模式(等待策略)</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>from<span>&nbsp;abc&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;ABC, abstractmethod<span><br><span><br><span>class<span>&nbsp;<span>WaitStrategy<span>(ABC)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>"""<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; """<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>wait_for<span>(self, driver, locator, timeout=<span>10<span>)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return<span>&nbsp;WebDriverWait(driver, timeout).until(<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>"""<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; 等待元素可点击策略<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; """<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>wait_for<span>(self, driver, locator, timeout=<span>10<span>)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return<span>&nbsp;WebDriverWait(driver, timeout).until(<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; EC.element_to_be_clickable(locator)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; )<span><br><span><br><span>class<span>&nbsp;<span>PresenceStrategy<span>(WaitStrategy)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>"""<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; 等待元素存在策略<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; """<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>wait_for<span>(self, driver, locator, timeout=<span>10<span>)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return<span>&nbsp;WebDriverWait(driver, timeout).until(<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; EC.presence_of_element_located(locator)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; )<span><br><span><br># 使用策略模式的高级页面基类<span><br><span>class<span>&nbsp;<span>AdvancedBasePage<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>__init__<span>(self, driver)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; self.driver = driver<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; self.wait_strategies = {<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;"visible"<span>: VisibilityStrategy(),<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;"clickable"<span>: ClickableStrategy(),<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;"present"<span>: PresenceStrategy()<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>find_element<span>(self, locator, strategy=<span>"present"<span>)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return<span>&nbsp;self.wait_strategies[strategy].wait_for(self.driver, locator)<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>

<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>2. 窗口与标签页管理</span></h3>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>switch_to_window_by_title<span>(driver, title)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;"""切换到指定标题的窗口"""<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; current_window = driver.current_window_handle<span><br><span>&nbsp; <h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>4. 文件上传与下载</span></h3>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>文件上传</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>upload_file<span>(driver, file_input_locator, file_path)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>"""<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; 上传文件(适用于&lt;input type="file"&gt;元素)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; 上传文件(适用于没有可见&lt;input type="file"&gt;的情况)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; 使用JS创建一个隐藏的文件输入元素<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; """<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;try<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; <h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>文件下载</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>import<span>&nbsp;os<span><br>import<span>&nbsp;time<span><br>from<span>&nbsp;pathlib&nbsp;import<span>&nbsp;Path<span><br><span><br><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>setup_chrome_download_path<span>(download_dir)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>"""<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; 设置Chrome浏览器的下载路径<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; """<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; options = webdriver.ChromeOptions()<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; prefs = {<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>"""<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; 等待下载完成<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; """<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; start_time = time.time()<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;while<span>&nbsp;time.time() - start_time &lt; timeout:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;# 检查是否有部分下载的文件(.crdownload, .part等)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; downloading_files = list(Path(download_dir).glob("*.crdownload"<span>)) + list(Path(download_dir).glob("*.part"<span>))<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;ifnot<span>&nbsp;downloading_files:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;# 找出最近下载的文件<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; downloaded_files = list(Path(download_dir).glob("*"<span>))<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;if<span>&nbsp;downloaded_files:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; downloaded_files.sort(key=lambda<span>&nbsp;x: x.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True<span>)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return<span>&nbsp;str(downloaded_files[0<span>])<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; time.sleep(check_interval)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;raise<span>&nbsp;TimeoutError("文件下载超时"<span>)<span><br><span><br><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>download_file<span>(driver, download_button_locator, download_dir, timeout=<span>60<span>)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>"""<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; 下载文件<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; """<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;try<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;# 确保下载目录存在<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;except<span>&nbsp;Exception&nbsp;as<span>&nbsp;e:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print(<span>f"文件下载失败:&nbsp;<span>{e}<span>"<span>)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;returnNone<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>5. 截图与日志</span></h3>

<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>6. 高级断言与验证</span></h3>

<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>性能优化与调试技巧</span></h2>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>1. 性能测试与优化</span></h3>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>测量页面加载时间</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>measure_page_load_time<span>(driver, url)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>"""<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; 测量页面加载时间<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; """<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; start_time = time.time()<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; driver.get(url)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;# 等待页面完全加载<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; WebDriverWait(driver,&nbsp;60<span>).until(<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;lambda<span>&nbsp;d: d.execute_script("return document.readyState"<span>) ==&nbsp;"complete"<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; )<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; end_time = time.time()<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; load_time = end_time - start_time<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return<span>&nbsp;load_time<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>使用Performance API获取详细性能数据</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>get_performance_metrics<span>(driver)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>"""<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; 获取浏览器性能指标<span><br><span>&nbsp; <h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>优化执行速度</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>optimize_chrome_for_performance<span>()<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>"""<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; 优化Chrome浏览器以提高性能<span><br><span>&nbsp; <h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>2. 高级调试技巧</span></h3>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>获取浏览器控制台日志</span></h4>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>get_browser_logs<span>(driver)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>"""<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; 获取浏览器控制台日志<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; """<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; logs = driver.get_log('browser'<span>)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return<span>&nbsp;logs<span><br><span><br><span>def<span>&nbsp;<span>print_browser_logs<span>(driver)<span>:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>"""<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; 打印浏览器控制台日志<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; """<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; logs = driver.get_log('browser'<span>)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;for<span>&nbsp;log&nbsp;in<span>&nbsp;logs:<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print(<span>f"[<span>{log[<span>'level'<span>]}<span>]&nbsp;<span>{log[<span>'message'<span>]}<span>"<span>)</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
